name: Header
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize, then select Theme Settings and Header.
Select your Main menu and sticky preference, then open the active header section to review its own settings. Each header layout can offer local overrides.
Preview dropdowns and the mobile menu after adding nested menu items. Keep announcement copy brief and truthful.
Set shared defaults here. A section with its own override may retain that override; select the section to adjust it.
Preview a home, product, collection, and cart page before saving shared changes.

settings.content: Choose and arrange header designs in the Header section group in the editor sidebar.

settings.label: Enable announcement bar
settings.info: Header One default. Other header designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Turn on “Enable announcement bar” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Announcement text
settings.info: Header One default. Other header designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Enter the announcement text. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Desktop primary navigation
settings.info: Fallback for Headers One, Three, Four and Five when their menu is blank. Header Two uses menu blocks.
settings.how: Create or edit a menu in Content > Menus, then select it here. Nest links to create dropdown levels. Preview both desktop navigation and the mobile menu.

settings.label: Sticky header
settings.info: Header One default. Other header designs use their own section controls.
settings.how: Turn on “Sticky header” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
